customer_question: The Product Publication Date we set (January 1) has already passed when we submitted the registration. Also, is there an official Bluetooth certificate we can download from the SIG?
question_variants: Product Publication Date has already passed — can it still be set to a future date?
Does the Bluetooth SIG issue a downloadable certificate for registered products?
What document proves Bluetooth certification if there is no official certificate?
actual_issue: The customer set January 1 as the Product Publication Date for their registration, but the date had already passed by the time of submission. This meant the product listing would appear publicly immediately. The customer also inquired about obtaining an official Bluetooth certificate, which they expected to exist as a formal issued document similar to radio certifications.
plain_english_explanation: Product Publication Date: The SIG portal allows customers to update their Product Publication Date at any time — even after submission, up until the product is publicly listed. The customer corrected their date from January 1 (already passed) to April 1 on the SIG HP (customer portal) before final Submission, preventing immediate public listing. For the certificate: the Bluetooth SIG discontinued issuing official downloadable certificates approximately 10 years ago. There is no longer a certificate PDF that can be downloaded from the SIG portal. Instead, the SDoC.pdf (Statement of Conformity) that is generated by the SIG system and included in the Compliance Folder serves as the modern equivalent — it is the official proof of Bluetooth qualification.
consultant_answer: Publication Date: The date can be updated by the customer directly in the SIG portal before or after submission — it is not locked at time of submission. The customer successfully changed from January 1 (past) to April 1 (future). Certificate: The official downloadable Bluetooth SIG certificate was discontinued approximately 10 years ago. The SDoC.pdf generated by the SIG system (included in the Compliance Folder) is now the accepted substitute for the former certificate. There is no separate certificate PDF available from the SIG portal.
decision_logic: Product Publication Date is customer-editable in the SIG portal and can be set to a future date at any time before the product becomes publicly listed. The SDoC.pdf is the de facto certificate — it is SIG-generated and legally recognized as the qualification proof document.
final_recommendation: Always confirm the Product Publication Date is set to the intended public listing date and has not already passed at time of submission. For customers asking about a 'certificate', explain that the SDoC.pdf within the Compliance Folder is the current standard proof document.
risk_if_done_wrong: An already-passed Publication Date results in immediate public listing of the product — a confidentiality risk for pre-launch products. Customers expecting a certificate PDF may be blocked in their product approval processes if they are not informed that SDoC.pdf is the valid substitute.
